CMS — Crypto, Memecoins & Stocks

One dashboard, three asset classes: top coins by market cap, dedicated memecoins, and a curated set of public stocks — real market data throughout. Momentum is one signal among several (alongside gainers, losers, volume, and risk) — not the headline. Risk Score is a transparent heuristic, not an on-chain audit. Analytics shows real technical indicators (candlesticks, moving averages, RSI, volatility bands) computed from actual price history — they describe the past, they don't predict the future. Nothing here is financial advice.

Relative Performance Comparison

Pick up to 3 assets to compare, indexed to 100 at the start of the 30-day window — a level playing field to see who actually outperformed.
Only a curated set of major coins/memecoins has 30-day OHLC history for real technical indicators (CoinGecko rate-limits this heavily) — the Overview, search, and heatmap cover the full tracked set.

Crypto & memecoin data: CoinGecko public market API, fetched live from your browser each time you load this page (market data, sparklines, the trending feed, and 30-day OHLC candles fetched on demand per asset in Analytics). Stock data: Yahoo Finance, also fetched live — quotes and 3-month daily OHLC for a curated list. Neither feed is real-time tick-by-tick data; both can occasionally fail to load (rate limits, network issues), in which case this page automatically falls back to the last known snapshot for whatever failed — check the status line above the stats for which parts are live right now. Momentum, gainers/ losers/volume leaderboards, and technical indicators (candlesticks, SMA, RSI, volatility bands) are transparent, rules-based summaries of past price/volume activity — not investment advice, not predictions of future performance. Risk Score is a heuristic from market cap, volatility, and liquidity turnover; it cannot see holder concentration, liquidity-lock status, or contract audits, which matter most for actual rug-pull risk. Portfolio data lives only in your browser's local storage — export regularly. Memecoins carry extreme volatility and risk of total loss. Do your own research.
